title.en: Flip One Bit: Testing Cryptographic Code Without Knowing the Right Answer
title.zh: 翻转一个比特：不知道正确答案，怎么测试密码代码

summary.en: Cryptographic outputs look random, so you cannot check them against a known answer. But you can flip one bit and compare. A walk through a TCHES 2026 paper, the bugs it found in NTRU, Falcon and CROSS, and what the NGCC review shows it still misses.
summary.zh: 密码算法的输出看起来是随机的，没法和正确答案比较，但可以翻转一个比特再比较。本文介绍一篇 TCHES 2026 论文的方法、它在 NTRU、Falcon、CROSS 中找到的 bug，以及 NGCC 公开评审显示它还会漏掉什么。

title.en: From Software to Silicon: A Beginner's Guide to Pavona
title.zh: 从软件到芯片：Pavona 入门指南

summary.en: A beginner-friendly tour of Pavona's hardware and cryptographic software, with a first ACC program you can run without a board.
summary.zh: 从 Ibex、ACC 与 KMAC 的分工讲起，了解 Pavona 的密码软件栈，并在没有开发板的情况下运行第一个 ACC 程序。

title.en: Engineering PQC Implementations: From the NIST Call to Implementation Pitfalls, Side Channels, and Testing
title.zh: PQC 方案实现工程教程：从 NIST 征集到实现陷阱、侧信道与测试

summary.en: Lessons from NIST, KpqC, and the first NGCC round on where PQC implementations break, how to defend against side channels, and how to test against the spec. Ends with a pre-submission checklist.
summary.zh: 结合 NIST、KpqC 与 NGCC 首轮的经验，梳理 PQC 实现最常出错的地方、侧信道防护与 spec 一致性测试，并附提交前自查清单。
